name: Alchemy (RPC & Data)
description: The dominant EVM RPC, enhanced data APIs, and webhook infrastructure provider. Covers Base, Ethereum, and other EVM chains with enhanced transaction APIs, NFT data, token data, and real-time event webhooks. The default EVM data layer in production consumer and agent apps.

ecosystem_fit.notes: The default RPC and data provider for Base consumer apps. Referenced in Coinbase/Base documentation as the recommended infrastructure.
Long-standing dominant Ethereum RPC and enhanced data provider.
Used as the Base chain data layer under Farcaster miniapps.

common_pairings.context: Privy for wallet management; Alchemy as the RPC layer for chain reads and transaction submission.
OnchainKit's transaction components use Alchemy as the underlying RPC provider for Base.
Pimlico for AA bundler/paymaster; Alchemy for the underlying RPC and chain data in the same EVM stack.
wagmi hooks route through Alchemy RPC for all chain reads and transaction submissions on Ethereum/Base.
AgentKit uses Alchemy for chain data reads and webhook triggers in Base AI agent workflows.
Neynar for Farcaster social data; Alchemy for Base chain data. Used together in Farcaster miniapps.

trust_evidence.description: Alchemy is the dominant EVM infrastructure provider. Referenced as the recommended RPC in Coinbase/Base developer documentation.
Alchemy appears in every EVM production workflow in WORKFLOWS.md as the chain data layer. Privy + OnchainKit + Alchemy is the canonical Base consumer app stack.
Alchemy maintains alchemy-sdk (npm) with typed APIs for all enhanced endpoints, comprehensive webhook documentation, and active SDK maintenance.
Integrated by OnchainKit (official Coinbase pairing), referenced by Pimlico, wagmi examples, and AgentKit documentation.

sdk_migration.notes: Note: alchemy-sdk (chain-data) and @alchemy/aa-core (account-abstraction / Alchemy Account Kit) are separate products. Package detection must distinguish between them. alchemy-sdk → this record. @alchemy/aa-core → alchemy-account-kit record.

scale_guidance.hackathon: Free tier is sufficient. Never use public RPCs — Alchemy free tier is easy to get and prevents rate limit failures during development.
scale_guidance.mvp: Paid tier for any app expecting real users. Public RPCs will fail under load.
scale_guidance.production: Plan Alchemy compute unit budget before launch. Webhook reliability is critical for event-driven agents — test failure modes and implement retry logic.

alternatives.when_to_prefer: When multi-chain RPC support is needed beyond EVM (QuickNode supports Solana, Aptos, and others). Also when QuickNode Yellowstone gRPC streaming is required for ultra-low-latency Solana data.

anti_patterns: Using public RPCs in production — Alchemy free tier is nearly free and prevents rate limit failures.
Conflating alchemy-sdk (this record / chain-data) with Alchemy Account Kit (@alchemy/aa-core / account-abstraction) — they are different products with different purposes.
Using Alchemy for Solana — Alchemy is EVM-only. Use Helius for Solana RPC and indexing.
